dedupe_keys.name: nationaal energie dashboard netherlands energy time series

description: Nationaal Energie Dashboard publishes historical, near-real-time and forecast energy series for the Netherlands. Its public catalogue enumerates electricity production by technology, electricity demand, gas consumption, storage and cross-border flows. Coverage includes national aggregates, provinces, offshore wind farms and named flow points, depending on the variable. The API guide defines capacity in kilowatts, energy in kilowatt-hours and emissions in kilograms, with intervals ranging from ten or fifteen minutes to annual aggregates. Several forecasts extend seven days, but archive start dates vary and were not established. Registered users receive an API key; documented response formats include JSON, XML and CSV. Access is free under custom terms that require attribution and restrict copying, distribution or sale to third parties without permission. A limitation is that many values are estimates, not direct measurements, and the terms do not grant an unrestricted open-data licence. Simulation uses include Dutch supply-demand calibration and flexibility scenarios. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. This is the canonical data service behind the curated CO2 Monitor entry; no registration, API-key request or time-series retrieval was performed. It complements data-entsoe-transparency-platform with Dutch estimates and forecasts; definitions require comparison before combining them.
